units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Add the stated vertical translation to the supplied ordinate.
units.summary: Map a point under a vertical translation.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Reflect the negative ordinate through the horizontal axis under the modulus operation.
units.summary: Map a point to a modulus-transformed graph.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Apply the horizontal translation, then scale and translate the supplied ordinate.
units.summary: Combine translations and a vertical stretch.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Substitute the root implied by the factor and solve the resulting linear parameter equation.
units.summary: Determine a polynomial parameter using a known factor.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Complete both squares and reuse the unprinted centre and radius to combine the centre–origin distance with the radius.
units.summary: Find a circle centre and radius, then its furthest distance from the origin.

exceptions: The raw (a)(ii) 3-mark tariff jointly covers centre (a)(i) and radius (a)(ii). These results are grouped with (b), where they are needed.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Interpret the reciprocal-function sum as an integral, evaluate the logarithmic antiderivative and combine endpoint logarithms.
units.summary: Evaluate a limiting sum by identifying its definite integral.

exceptions: Visually verified: the source sum has integrand 2/x, lower endpoint 2.1 and upper endpoint 6.3; the denominator is not an exponent.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Use squared observed heights to solve two linear parameter equations, then reuse the fitted model to compare an independent observation.
units.summary: Fit and evaluate a tree-height model.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Read the interval between the two stated turning points where the gradient is negative.
units.summary: Identify a curve’s decreasing interval from its graph.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Use the turning-point heights and exclude the boundary levels that give two distinct intersections; express both intervals in set notation.
units.summary: Find horizontal levels meeting a cubic once.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Use the origin crossing, the tangent root at the minimum and the supplied maximum point to determine the polynomial scale.
units.summary: Construct a cubic from a crossing and a repeated root.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Assume both integers are odd, expand their product algebraically and contradict its given evenness.
units.summary: Prove a parity implication by contradiction.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Expand and cancel squares, then divide by a negative quantity and reverse the inequality.
units.summary: Prove an inequality using a negative input restriction.

exceptions: The two roman-numbered prompts are separate proofs; neither requires an answer to the other.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Use the later zero of the supplied speed expression to identify the second stop.
units.summary: Find the end time in a supplied speed model.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Differentiate the product involving ln(t+1), set the derivative to zero and rearrange to the printed fixed-point form.
units.summary: Derive an iterative stationary-speed equation.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: The recurrence and starting value are printed explicitly; calculate the requested iterate and continue to the stated precision.
units.summary: Iterate a supplied formula for the time of maximum speed.

exceptions: The raw (c)(ii) 3-mark tariff jointly assesses (c)(i) and (c)(ii). The recurrence is reprinted before (c), so no unprinted answer from (b) is supplied.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Compare three-dimensional side magnitudes, then form the two diagonal vectors and use their perpendicular-bisector geometry to obtain area.
units.summary: Prove a parallelogram is a rhombus and find its exact area.

exceptions: The mark scheme permits area from the two vector diagonal lengths; a cross product or scalar product is not required.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Evaluate the supplied bee model at zero and interpret the stated thousands unit.
units.summary: Find an exponential population model’s initial count.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Differentiate the supplied e^(0.05t) model and evaluate the rate after ten years; this exponential-gradient content is within AS scope.
units.summary: Find a population’s exponential growth rate.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Equate the fully supplied models, substitute an exponential variable to solve a quadratic and use logarithms to recover time.
units.summary: Find when two exponential populations are equal.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Evaluate both supplied curve equations at the stated half-unit input and compare ordinates.
units.summary: Verify an intersection of two polynomial curves.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed Year 1/AS skill scope.
units.difficulty_basis: Equate the curves, use the intersection input explicitly printed in (a) to factor the cubic, then solve the remaining quadratic and enforce positive x.
units.summary: Find a second exact intersection of polynomial curves.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Select integration by parts, integrate the residual power and evaluate both exponential and unit endpoints.
units.summary: Evaluate a definite polynomial–logarithm integral.

exceptions: Source rendering confirms integral from 1 to e² of x³ ln(x), with the requested result ae⁸+b.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Pair the series with its reverse or an equivalent algebraic argument to derive the printed formula for general n.
units.summary: Derive the arithmetic-series sum formula.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Use the sum formula explicitly printed in (i) with the first weekly saving and common difference, then rearrange the target sum to the printed quadratic.
units.summary: Form an arithmetic savings equation.

units.introduced_year_basis: The selected tariffs assess solving a supplied quadratic and interpreting its two roots; no arithmetic-series formula needs to be derived or used.
units.difficulty_basis: Factor the equation explicitly repeated in (b), then reuse its two roots to select the earlier week at which the target is reached.
units.summary: Solve a savings quadratic and select the first feasible purchase time.

exceptions: The nested (ii)(a)–(c) labels are extracted as (a), (b), (c); display labels restore the original hierarchy. The sum formula and the quadratic are both printed source results.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Expand both angles, use exact special-angle values and collect sine and cosine terms to establish the printed tangent result.
units.summary: Derive a tangent equation from compound-angle expressions.

units.introduced_year_basis: The compound-angle deduction is supplied as the printed result in (a); the selected tariff can be solved with AS degree-equation and periodicity skills.
units.difficulty_basis: Identify x=2θ+60° in the equation explicitly printed in (a), solve the resulting tangent equation and retain both roots in the stated degree interval.
units.summary: Solve a transformed trigonometric equation using a supplied result.

exceptions: Visually verified: (a) concludes tan(x)=3√3. Part (b) can reuse this printed result with x=2θ+60°, without repeating the unscored compound-angle proof.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Use the radian sector area and arc length, eliminate the prism depth with its fixed volume and simplify the rational surface-area expression.
units.summary: Derive the surface-area model of a sector-shaped prism.

units.introduced_year_basis: The selected tariffs use standard power differentiation and the second-derivative test on a supplied formula; the radian geometry was assessed separately in (a).
units.difficulty_basis: Differentiate the rational-power expression explicitly printed in (a), solve its stationary equation and reuse the resulting radius in a second-derivative minimum check.
units.summary: Find and classify the minimum of a supplied surface-area function.

exceptions: Sector-prism geometry and source formula S=0.8r²+1680/r visually verified. Parts (b),(c) are grouped because the stationary radius is unprinted.

units.introduced_year_basis: Assessed additional A level skill scope, beyond the AS subset.
units.difficulty_basis: Convert the area to y(dx/dt), select the parameter limit from x=4, use double-angle identities and reuse the unprinted limit to integrate the mixed trigonometric expression.
units.summary: Find an exact parametric area with trigonometric identities.

exceptions: Visually verified: x=8sin²(t), y=2sin(2t)+3sin(t); the supplied integrand contains cos(4t), not cos⁴(t). Part (a) leaves the upper limit a to be found, so (b) is grouped with it.
